tools.name: ci_log
tools.title: CI Log
tools.description: Read CI telemetry from qyl when the user wants recent runs or a per-leg phase breakdown with failures first. Any CI can emit this convention: resource service.name starts with service_prefix (default 'qyl-ci'), session.id identifies the run, and one span per phase carries a ci.leg attribute; failed phases set span status to error. Without run_id, filters the 50 most recent sessions and returns up to limit matching runs (default 10). With run_id, reads up to 100 traces for that session and returns only phases matching the same case-sensitive service prefix; phase output can be large.

run_id.description: Session id of one CI run for a per-leg phase breakdown; omit to list recent runs.

service_prefix.description: Case-sensitive service-name prefix identifying CI telemetry in both run lists and phase breakdowns.

run_id.description: Unique session identifier: URL-safe characters, at least one, at most 128, not only dots. The same rule the SDK enforces on the baggage header.

error_count.description: Spans in the run that ended with an error status.

services.description: Service names observed in the run, at least one of which is CI-emitted.

items.description: One CI run, summarized from the session its telemetry is grouped under.

run_id.description: Unique session identifier: URL-safe characters, at least one, at most 128, not only dots. The same rule the SDK enforces on the baggage header.

leg.description: Value of the span's ci.leg attribute, falling back to its service name.

phase.description: Span name, which the CI emitter convention sets to the phase name.

status.description: Outcome of one CI phase span, projected from its OpenTelemetry span status.

message.description: Span status message, present on a failed phase.

items.description: One phase span of a CI run, attributed to the leg that executed it.

mode.description: Whether a qyl MCP tool read live collector data or the explicit demo dataset.

code.description: Stable failure code of a qyl MCP tool result. A model branches on the code, never on the message.

retryable.description: Whether the same call can succeed when repeated unchanged.

outputSchema.description: Structured output for ci_log: recent runs, or one run's phases.

tools.name: get_trace
tools.title: Get Trace
tools.description: Fetch a single qyl trace by trace_id when the user wants span timing, events, status, and attributes. By default returns all spans; errors_only keeps error spans, max_spans caps them after filtering in Collector order, and include_attributes=false omits attribute collections. Trace totals are preserved and the summary reports returned and matching counts. The root span is omitted when excluded by the filter or cap. It also returns the annotations on the trace and its spans, with the id and etag that update_annotation and delete take. display_traces provides the visual waterfall.

include_attributes.description: Include span, resource, event and link attributes; false omits those attribute collections.
